offers_products.reason: Sells trading, post-trade and wealth software platforms (order management, AdvisorStream) licensed or hosted as SaaS to financial firms.

offers_services.reason: Proxy and regulatory communications, investor communications distribution, and outsourced trade processing/operations are major service offerings.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are banks, broker-dealers, asset managers, wealth firms and corporate issuers; investors receive communications but don't choose the purchase.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to financial institutions, asset managers, wealth firms and corporations needing proxy and regulatory communications.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largely recurring proxy, communications and trade-processing fees plus multi-year platform contracts from the same financial-firm clients.

cyclical_demand.reason: Regulatory-mandated proxy, communications and trade processing are essential; clients can't easily cut them in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue is mostly per-event, volume-based processing and communications fees, and recurring platform fees, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from its technology platforms and processing infrastructure, not mainly from staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main clients are large banks, broker-dealers, asset managers and public companies; 25 of top 25 North American wealth providers.

asset_heavy.reason: Technology and processing business with mostly software, data and print/distribution operations, not heavy plants or fleets.
